name: forgemind
description: Evidence-first discovery and autonomous delivery for Codex: scored experiments, visual evidence, safe execution, and release-ready decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Scored discovery, safe delivery, and verifiable release evidence.
interface.longDescription: ForgeMind turns product uncertainty into scored experiments and verified delivery. It composes focused roles, preserves resumable checkpoints, captures local visual evidence, creates capability manifests, and routes work through the smallest sufficient workflow. YOLO mode remains available for bounded fast MVPs while destructive, credential, production, and high-stakes actions always stop for approval. All records stay local on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
defaultPrompt: Use ForgeMind to inspect this repository and recommend the smallest safe workflow.
Use ForgeMind to build this outcome end to end with governed evidence and safe escalation.
Use the Trust Fabric to produce portable proof and a release-ready Go/No-Go decision.
